details: US April PCE inflation rose 3.8% year-over-year, the highest since May 2023, while core PCE saw a modest 0.2% month-over-month increase. First-quarter GDP was revised down to 1.6% annualized. Federal Reserve officials are maintaining a hawkish stance, with some suggesting a rate hike scenario if disinflation doesn't materialize, despite one rate cut being projected for 2026. This prolonged high-rate environment is impacting capital flows into risk-on assets.
sourceName: Saxo Bank (Bloomberg, Wall Street Journal, KuCoin, Rain, Bond Buyer also report similar views).
title: US Macro Data Shows Persistent Inflation Amid Hawkish Fed Remarks

details: Spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have experienced record outflows, totaling $2.8 billion over the past nine days, with Bitcoin plunging below $73,000 to a six-week low. These significant withdrawals, coupled with sustained institutional de-risking, are attributed to broader macroeconomic uncertainty and lingering geopolitical tensions, signaling decreased investor confidence in risk assets.
sourceName: Crypto Briefing (24/7 Wall St., Charles Schwab, ETF Database also report similar views).
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Record Outflows as Institutional De-risking Continues

details: Hopes for an extension of the US-Iran ceasefire are improving overall risk sentiment, which has eased some pressure on oil prices and inflation expectations. However, geopolitical uncertainty around the prolonged blockade of the Strait of Hormuz continues to push inflationary expectations higher, contributing to market volatility. Bitcoin fell despite a weakening US Dollar, indicating specific pressures on the cryptocurrency market.
sourceName: AMP (Saxo Bank, 24/7 Wall St., Charles Schwab, ETF Database, Rain also report similar views).
title: Geopolitical Tensions & Oil Prices Drive Market Uncertainty

details: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has granted a regulatory green light for US firms to offer perpetual futures trading. This development is significant as perpetual futures are a popular derivative contract in the crypto world. The news contributed to a surge in the stock of commission-free trading platforms like Robinhood, despite Bitcoin's recent struggles.
title: CFTC Approves US Perpetual Futures Trading

details: A landmark regulatory update from the SEC and CFTC in March officially distinguishes digital asset commodities from securities. Crucially, the new guidance acknowledges that a crypto asset can shed its security classification over time, reversing the SEC's prior stance. This change is expected to allow separated assets to trade on platforms not registered as national securities exchanges, which could lead to easier custody, increased liquidity, and a more mature market for various tokens.
title: SEC and CFTC Clarify Crypto Asset Classification, Boosting Liquidity Potential

details: The U.S. Department of the Treasury's FinCEN and OFAC have issued a joint proposed rule to implement the GENIUS Act (Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act). This regulation aims to treat permitted payment stablecoin issuers (PPSIs) as financial institutions under the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), imposing anti-money laundering (AML) and sanctions compliance obligations. The goal is to encourage innovation in payment stablecoins while mitigating illicit finance risks.
title: Treasury Proposes Rules for Stablecoin Regulation Under GENIUS Act
